title: Snake Game where you can make real money
author: LongSconce
selftext:
Hello, just wondering if anyone would play this game. You queue against three other players and the top 3 winners earn real money (the Solana Cryptocurrency). Please post in the comments if you'd play this and i'll release it, thank you.

  
This is heavily inspired by Slither.io. I created this using Claude Code, JS, Typescript and Webgl. I coded some of it myself and some with the use of Claude, but I had the idea and vision.

comments.author: angrylittledev
comments.body: Any time people say "earn real money" and then follow up with some crypto currency, it's  a scam stay away from it. Nobody gives money for free or for playing games to anyone, ever, if they're not making that money back or more. No sane business would ever give money for free.

replies.author: LongSconce
replies.body:
It's not free money. Each player pays 0.05 SOL to enter in their four person tournament. The top 3 winners make profit, fourth place loses money. I show the earnings here.

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body: its basically [snake.io](http://snake.io) or [slither.io](http://slither.io) or similar games, this looks like a worse version of those.  Your video would give some people seizures and your earn money thing will never work, most people see these as a scam, and if if not these things never really make money. You would either need people to put money in  which is gambling, and depending on where you hosting could have your domain and server seized, or you would need heavy add and Sols you get are a "membership" which won't work without larger numbers. If this took 6 months I'd reevaluate your workflow. That video was enough to tell me I'd not be interested so maybe review that.
